Here are some notable GitHub repositories for Svelte markdown editor libraries and applications found via code search:

- [pd4d10/hashmd](embed:hashmd-0eF): A hackable Markdown editor and viewer built with TypeScript and Svelte.
- [BearToCode/carta](embed:carta-EvL): A lightweight, fast, and extensible Svelte Markdown editor and viewer supporting Katex, math, and slash commands.
- [rossrobino/typo](embed:typo-Q6E): A web-based Markdown editor built with [Svelte](wiki:Svelte) and SvelteKit.
- [lockedmutex/rhyolite](embed:rhyolite-CNe): A simple markdown editor and knowledge base built with Rust, Tauri, and Svelte.
- [ajkdrag/otterly](embed:otterly-dRR): A local-first, privacy-focused WYSIWYG Markdown vault with full-text search and wiki-links, built using [Tauri](wiki:Tauri_(software)), Svelte, and Rust.
- [vaibhav-kakde-in/mdhero](embed:mdhero-e7E): A native Markdown viewer and lightweight editor for desktop systems using Tauri and Svelte.

```embeds_results_view
title: Svelte Markdown Editors
embeds: hashmd-0eF, carta-EvL, typo-Q6E, rhyolite-CNe, otterly-dRR, mdhero-e7E
```
